verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a local inference engine with a CLI, a server and a built-in web UI, so connecting to cloud providers in the same interface is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the web UI or CLI can connect to remote or cloud AI providers alongside local GGUF models. The only documented model source is local or Hugging Face-downloaded GGUF models run on local hardware.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
